about: Fastiv: a railway town with private housing

Fastiv is a major railway junction south-west of Kyiv, with a compact centre, a few apartment-block estates and a large private sector. Typical requests from here are renovating apartments in older buildings and rebuilding family houses.

Many houses in Fastiv and the district were built decades ago without a project: extensions, floors from different years, old services. Before renovating we do a survey to know what the new interior will rest on.

For Fastiv houses the design often starts with replanning: getting rid of walk-through rooms, making a proper bathroom and a kitchen-living room. We prepare the drawings so that the estimate has no unknown works. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate houses and apartments turnkey or individual rooms — a [bathroom](/en/bathroom-renovation), a kitchen, a WC. In Fastiv district we build aerated-block, brick and [timber-frame houses](/en/timber-frame-house), starting with [house design](/en/house-design) for the plot. Fastiv is further from Kyiv, so the crew works on site in blocks.

The same salaried team as in Kyiv, at the same rates: renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), and if CAS carries out the renovation, the final total stays within ±5% of the estimate. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m²; 12-month warranty on works. More on [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Our site managers include visits to the town in their normal schedule, just as for Kyiv districts, and materials come from Kyiv warehouses. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks; an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
